snippet.title: Palia | Elderwood Expansion Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into an ancient overgrown forest teeming with magic in the Elderwood Expansion — Palia’s biggest update to date! Welcome home... Welcome to the Elderwood... 🌳🔮🍄

🎮  Play now on PlayStation® 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010001
🕹️ Play now Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/palia/9MTLHG50W87K!
🍃 Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707930/Palia/
🌳  Read the full patch notes here: https://palia.com/news/patch-191
🍄  Refer A Friend to earn exclusive rewards! https://palia.com/refer-a-friend
